name: After § 149
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: 149 b. Notes the line item regarding “Non-reimbursable expenses following reclassifications,” totaling over 2 million euro reclassified by DG FINS, to which over 1 million euro is added in reclassifications for European foundations; regrets that this information was provided after the adoption of this discharge resolution by the CONT Committee, preventing it from making a fully informed decision;
